name: Indigo Paper
scope: Public coloring-page gallery routes and shared public shell.

futureStudioShell.note: The future online coloring workspace may use a separate darker, focused shell. That shell must not replace or bleed into the public gallery shell.

colorRules: Neutral colors carry most of the public interface.
Primary is reserved for main CTAs, active states, important links, and selected chips.
Secondary is reserved for warm editorial emphasis and seasonal highlights.
Accent is reserved for supportive positive or action cues.
Do not use all accent colors at equal strength in the same viewport.
Do not use color alone to communicate state.

layoutTargets.largeHubRule: Use pagination or limited initial rendering.
